family.references: jointMetric vs independently tuned original knn; ridgeH vs independently tuned stage-matched ridge
family.secondary: original-only and E1-only maxima; never substitute for combined primary
family.selection: unweighted mean NSE of the two inner validation embryos; exact numerical ties resolved lexicographically by parameter tuple
family.simultaneous_statistic: maximum member statistic over all 76 members
family.statistic: minimum of the three foldwise molecular-minus-history NSE gains, including nonpositive minima
family.unit: stage_configuration_history_model, summarized over the three outer embryos

null.decision: combined corrected p <= 0.05 and positive observed minimum -> FAMILY_WISE_LINEAGE_SIGNAL under declared conditional null; otherwise FINITE_POSITIVE_CONFIGURATION_WITHOUT_FAMILY_WISE_SUPPORT when observed positive members exist; no positive member -> NO_POSITIVE_CONFIGURATION_AFTER_REPLAY; invalid/incomplete replay -> UNRESOLVED_NULL_AUTHORITY
null.execution: At most two numerical worker processes, checkpoint by permutation. Runtime measurement after freeze changes scheduling only, not B, strata, family, statistic or decision rule. No outcome-based pruning.
null.implementation: float64 exact nearest-neighbor selection, optional certified nonnegative-history-distance pruning and algebraically equivalent block ridge solves; require observed replay and independent direct-solver checks before accepting accelerated results
null.molecular_strata: For each embryo, use the canonical 64D state hash based only on that embryo's eligible state-panel genes. Within each embryo/S0 block, repeatedly take the lowest remaining source-order cell and group it with its nearest remaining cells until 32 cells or the remaining block is exhausted. Distance ties use source order. No target or history enters partitioning.
null.nested_replay: Repeat all history-bearing candidate evaluations and parameter selection in each realization. Molecular-only tuning is exactly invariant and reused, not altered by the null.
null.ownership: Permutations never cross embryos. A single permuted feature assignment is used in all inner and outer fits. TRAIN-derived standardization is refitted; eligibility, state and target frames are invariant because neither counts nor targets change.
null.p_value: (1 + number of null family maxima >= observed statistic)/(999 + 1); inclusive upper-tail ties; minimum 0.001
null.qualification: Conditional randomization calibration assumes exchangeability of history tuples within declared finite strata. It does not prove conditional independence given an arbitrary continuous molecular state or population-level biological replication.
null.seed: SHA256 first 8 bytes, big endian, of RMMO_P2_REFEREE02_LINEAGE_NULL_{b}, b=0..998
null.support: Whole tuple reassignment preserves joint feature support, marginal embryo/S0 distributions, molecular-stratum history multisets, and source tree topology up to terminal-cell relabeling; it does not fabricate independent tree features.
null.transformation: one synchronized permutation of complete seven-feature history tuples across all configurations and both stages

release: prepare isolated ordinary-file surface, current author draft if supplied, updated scientific specification and finite tables; no third-party raw data, private URLs, local paths, symlinks or tokens; external publication requires separate approval

baselines: mean of normalized training target coordinates
mean of normalized training target coordinates within matching historical S0, global normalized-coordinate mean fallback
target_PCA.coordinates: row L2-normalize projected coordinates for matching REFEREE-01 metrics; save raw centered projections and loadings too. A numerically zero global centered mean has no direction: define global baseline as the exact zero vector, not normalization of rounding noise.
target_PCA.decision: NSE molecular < S0 in all three outer folds -> NONHASH_TARGET_REPLICATES_3OF3; one or two -> NONHASH_TARGET_PARTIAL; zero -> NONHASH_TARGET_FAILS
target_PCA.eligibility: detection >= 0.01 in every available fit embryo, positive fit-set mean, exclude mt-/Mt-/MT-/Rpl/Rps prefixes; SHA256 panel assignment from the same immutable rule
target_PCA.fit: center and top 32 singular vectors using only the fitting cells; sparse centered ARPACK tol 1e-8 maxiter 5000; seed RMMO_P2_REFEREE02_TARGET_PCA_V0; descending singular values; largest-absolute loading entry positive, first gene-order index resolves ties; training Gram eigensolver fallback only on solver failure
target_PCA.metrics: REFEREE-01 row-normalized prediction NSE, cosine and coordinate MAE; all baselines frame-matched. Also report unnormalized centered-PC squared error divided by fit mean squared PC norm, with exact-zero centered global baseline, as fixed sensitivity, never select between metrics.
target_PCA.nested_tuning: rebuild eligibility, panel denominator, canonical state hash and target PCA on each single inner-fit embryo. Select k in [10,25,50] by mean inner NSE; then fit outer target PCA on the other two embryos, excluding held-out embryo throughout
target_PCA.normalization: log1p(10000 * target gene count / sum of eligible target-panel counts), separate from state-panel denominator
target_PCA.optional_gene_level: not a closure requirement; no outcome-adaptive target dimension or additional configuration search

validation: hash every REFEREE-01 artifact including its manifest, verify plan-only commit and hashes; 999 complete synchronous replay receipts; frame ownership/disjointness; accelerated-vs-direct numerical checks; all displayed results regenerated; standalone public isolation validation
